channel.title: The Smithfield Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Smithfield Times (smithfieldtimes.com)

item.title: Six homes briefly evacuated during Feb. 17 ammonia leak at cold storage warehouse
item.description: Additional details are known two days after an ammonia leak at the vacant Lineage Logistics cold storage warehouse on Old Stage Highway closed the road for hours.

item.title: Gun law roundup: Speakers urge reaffirming IW as ‘constitutional county’
item.description: Amid new gun bills in Richmond, Isle of Wight residents pressed county supervisors on Feb. 19 to reaffirm the pro-Second Amendment 'constitutional county' resolution adopted in 2019.

item.title: 10 Smart Ways to Cut Home Maintenance Costs Without Cutting Corners
item.description: Keeping a house in shape isn’t cheap.

item.title: Column – Americans’ fundamental rights are under assault
item.description: Columnist John Edwards argues Americans of every political stripe now enjoy fewer rights, citing new threats to religious freedom, free speech and a free press.

item.title: Bridge Point Commons approved 4-1 six months after prior failed vote
item.description: Isle of Wight supervisors reversed course, voting 4-1 to approve rezoning Bridge Point Commons on Feb. 19 after the developer amended the site plan and offered a cash proffer to offset the subdivision's impact on schools.

item.title: IW supervisors approve Kemp’s Village development 3-2
item.description: After a three-month delay, Isle of Wight supervisors voted 3-2 to approve Kemp’s Village, a 35-home mixed-use development in Carrollton.

item.title: Land withdrawal request tied to Old Stage Highway broadband antenna array
item.description: Isle of Wight planners will weigh a request Feb. 24 to withdraw one acre from the Moonlight agricultural district for a broadband antenna array off Old Stage Highway.

item.title: Tazewell court again blocks redistricting referendum
item.description: A Tazewell judge has again halted Virginia's April 21 redistricting referendum, issuing a 90-day temporary restraining order. Attorney General Jay Jones says he will appeal.

item.title: Letter – Citizen of the Year dinner canceled
item.description: Smithfield's Rotary and Ruritan clubs have canceled this year's Citizen of the Year dinner at honoree John Ormond’s request, citing his wish for privacy.

item.title: Westside High School sweethearts married 55 years publish their love story
item.description: Westside High sweethearts Claudia and James Tynes, married 55 years, shared their faith-rooted love story and lessons for a lasting marriage in a new book, “Signs of the Tynes.”
